name: Really Simple Security
storage_notes: All feature settings are one array option rsssl_options. On multisite with the plugin network-activated, the same key is read/written with get_site_option()/update_site_option(); otherwise get_option()/update_option(). Checkbox values are stored as int 0/1, hidden fields as sanitized titles, multiselects as arrays. Field definitions (allowed IDs, types, defaults) come from settings/config/fields/*.php and are exposed by rsssl_fields(). Separate options hold runtime flags: rsssl_current_version, rsssl_previous_version, rsssl_activation, rsssl_show_onboarding, rsssl_ssl_detection_overridden, rsssl_flush_caches, rsssl_activation_timestamp and rsssl_email_verification_status. 2FA per-user state is user meta, not an option.

settings.summary: Complete settings array. Do not overwrite wholesale: keys are defined by fields and writes should go through rsssl_update_option().

ssl_enabled.summary: Master SSL switch, normally set by activate_ssl().

site_has_ssl.summary: Result of SSL detection; can be overridden by option rsssl_ssl_detection_overridden.

redirect.summary: Redirect method: none, wp_redirect or htaccess.

mixed_content_fixer.summary: Rewrite insecure front-end URLs to HTTPS.

login_protection_enabled.summary: Enable Two-Factor Authentication (email method in free).

404_blocking_threshold.summary: 404 lockout threshold: disabled, lax, normal or strict (default lax).

disable_xmlrpc.summary: Disable XML-RPC (may be blocked when XML-RPC-dependent plugins are detected).

disable_file_editing.summary: Disable the built-in theme/plugin file editors.

hsts.summary: Send Strict-Transport-Security; requires SSL and writable wp-content.

notifications_email_address.summary: Recipient for security notification and test emails.

delete_data_on_uninstall.summary: Delete plugin data when the plugin is uninstalled.

settings.summary: Master SSL switch. Use RSSSL()->admin->activate_ssl() instead of writing directly; activation also sets redirect/mixed-content and site URLs.
Detected/overridden SSL availability. Written by detection; direct writes can mislead activation checks.
HTTPS redirect method: none, wp_redirect or htaccess. htaccess writes server config and can lock out a misconfigured site.
Enable front-end mixed-content rewriting; default true.
Enable 2FA login protection; free implementation supports the email provider.
Roles forced to enroll in 2FA (validated against rsssl_get_roles()).
Enable firewall rule generation/loader; writes .htaccess/advanced-cache files.
404 lockout threshold: disabled, lax, normal, strict; default lax. Disabled automatically when homepage has 404 resources.
Disable XML-RPC; enablement can be forced back to 0 by a block-reason callback when dependent plugins exist.
Enable HSTS; requires SSL and writable wp-content, and is high-impact for browsers.
Delete all plugin data on uninstall.

meta.summary: Per-user email 2FA status: active, open or disabled. Read with Rsssl_Two_Factor_Settings::get_user_status('email',$user_id).
meta.format_notes: Do not write directly; use the provider/enrollment flows. Direct changes can lock users out (status values set at providers/class-rsssl-two-factor-email.php:245,567).

meta.summary: Per-user TOTP status; TOTP provider is a Pro-flagged feature in free.
meta.format_notes: Read-only; no TOTP enrollment should be attempted from free.

meta.summary: Timestamp of last 2FA login; used for reminder/grace calculations.
meta.format_notes: Maintained by authentication code; do not edit.

actions.name: update_setting
actions.summary: Update one configured setting by field ID. Rejects unknown fields, sanitizes by field type, saves network option when applicable, clears notice cache and fires rsssl_after_save_field.

actions.name: activate_ssl
actions.summary: Run SSL activation: requires detected SSL or rsssl_ssl_detection_overridden/WP-CLI; sets redirect=wp_redirect, mixed_content_fixer=true, ssl_enabled=true, updates siteurl/home to https, flushes rewrite/caches.

actions.name: deactivate_ssl
actions.summary: Disable SSL features and clean up rules for the site/network.

actions.name: rebuild_advanced_headers
actions.summary: Request an advanced-headers/firewall file rebuild only.

actions.name: clear_test_caches
actions.summary: Clear cached security test results for a cache_id.

actions.name: run_fix
actions.summary: Run a registered fix by fix_id via the rsssl_run_fix filter.

actions.name: send_test_mail
actions.summary: Send the notification test email to the configured notifications_email_address.

actions.name: activate_recommended_features
actions.summary: Enable the plugin's recommended set: vulnerability scanner, recommended hardening, email login protection, mixed-content fixer; Pro-only extras only when rsssl_pro is defined.

rest_routes.permission: manage_security + nonce rsssl_nonce; only configured field IDs accepted.

objects.summary: The rsssl_options array (site option on network-activated multisite) with all feature flags.
objects.crud_notes: Read fields via rsssl_get_option($id) or rsssl_fields(true); update one field via rsssl_update_option($id,$value). Do not read/write get_option('rsssl_options') directly on multisite; use rsssl_is_networkwide_active() to select site option (functions.php:17-23,316).

objects.summary: Per-user 2FA state in rsssl_two_fa_status_email/_totp/_passkey plus rsssl_two_fa_last_login.
objects.crud_notes: List active email-2FA users with get_users(['meta_key'=>'rsssl_two_fa_status_email','meta_value'=>'active']) (security/wordpress/two-fa/class-rsssl-two-factor.php:270). Read one with Rsssl_Two_Factor_Settings::get_user_status($method,$user_id) (class-rsssl-two-factor-settings.php:377). Treat write as unsafe; use enrollment/reset flows.

detection.active_check: defined('rsssl_file') and defined('rsssl_version') (or class_exists('REALLY_SIMPLE_SSL')); version constant rsssl_version = 9.8.4.

pro_notes: Fields explicitly flagged premium in this free tree: enable_passkey_login (settings/config/fields/two-fa.php:48,52) and two_fa_enabled_roles_totp (settings/config/fields/two-fa.php:133,138). Free 2FA uses the email provider (security/wordpress/two-fa/providers/class-rsssl-two-factor-email.php:33).

activate_recommended_features() only enables the extended set (limit-login, firewall, event log, advanced headers) when the Pro constant rsssl_pro is defined (class-admin.php:3095-3105); treat those as Pro-documented, not guaranteed by the free UI.
gotchas: rsssl_update_option() requires current_user_can('manage_security') and silently no-ops for unknown field IDs (settings/settings.php:747-763; main file:252-267). Administrators receive manage_security on activation (main file:242-249); WP-CLI bypasses the cap.

On multisite network activation, rsssl_options is a site option; direct get_option()/update_option() targets the wrong row. Use rsssl_is_networkwide_active() and the helpers (functions.php:17-23,316).
Checkbox values are ints 0/1 after sanitization, while rsssl_get_option() converts 1 to true (settings/settings.php:846-851; functions.php:39-41).

Some saves are vetoed back to 0 by rsssl_prevent_enabling_blocked_security_features() when prerequisites fail (email verification, SSL, XML-RPC dependencies, firewall loader); re-read after writing (security/sync-settings.php:201-231).

Saving fields fires rsssl_after_saved_fields, which schedules .htaccess rebuilds and firewall installs; expect file writes/cache flushes (security/functions.php:986; security/firewall-manager.php:83).
activate_ssl() only succeeds when SSL is detected or rsssl_ssl_detection_overridden/WP-CLI is true; it updates siteurl/home to https and flushes rewrite/caches (class-admin.php:552-577,992).
HSTS and 404 blocking require SSL/writable wp-content and are high-impact; 404 blocking is disabled when the homepage itself returns 404 resources (security/functions.php:2245).
Email-dependent fields are gated by option rsssl_email_verification_status=completed (security/functions.php:2224-2231).
REST writes require both manage_security and nonce rsssl_nonce; direct PHP calls avoid nonce but should be capability-checked (settings/settings.php:640-658).
